title: Official Geometry and Feature binary methods for an explicit planar WGS84 subset
priority: Official GEE names, arguments and default behavior first; explicit-parameter subsets are not default compatibility. Original broader goal remains active.

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name inventory only, not full parameters, numerical semantics, spherical defaults or project migration success

implementation.official_contract: Required left/right and optional maxError/proj names retained; exact decoded explicit EPSG:4326, omitted/null maxError, finite valid2D inline values only. Every edge-bearing component needs explicit geodesic=false. Point/empty geometries have no edges.
implementation.operations: Actual local predicates and geometry Boolean results, stable unsupported errors; no DSL or dummy calculations. contains uses documented local GEOS interior/boundary semantics, not a Google oracle.
implementation.features: Actual finite inline Features with non-null geometry. Overlays detach left properties only and preserve actual left ID under the existing local identity policy. Arbitrary Element/Image/runtime overloads remain unsupported.
implementation.output: Actual output dimensions retained, empties canonicalized as GeometryCollection without NaN. Newly derived public GeoJSON exposes geodesic=false recursively and retains owned internal metadata; no invalid string CRS emitted. Official SDK roundtrip is covered.
implementation.work_and_ownership: Bounded raw structural scans and conservative closure counts avoid equality on mutable coordinate leaves. Input decode, cross/internal edge/vertex/point candidates, all-overlay children and output materialization admitted before GEOS. Full output reservation remains charged; child/depth bounds enforced before recursive copies. Fresh validation and detached results preserve input ownership.
implementation.unchanged_limits: Shared50000 work, graph500/1MB,10000 coordinates,1000 geometry children,16 geometry depth; existing collection/array/native work limits unchanged.

full_pytest.scope: Complete existing host suite; optional native cases retain their existing skips. No new native build or deployment.

original_explicit_probes.reference: Hand rectangle areas1/7/3/6 and literal predicate results; no Shapely operation used to generate these expectations

workflow.independent_reference: Raw Float64 band arithmetic and hand-listed rectangle/hole pixel-center indices; synthetic sample graph evaluation, not native raster execution
workflow.CSV: 4 synthetic feature overlay rows actually written and read through existing task/artifact pipeline; actual left IDs, properties and hole rings checked

negative_controls: spherical/default projection, non4326, non-null maxError reject
ambiguous/default non-point edges, true geodesic and evenOdd=false reject
mutated coordinates and sidecar flags freshly validate
cycles and opaque coordinate leaves reject without premature equality
point-only and internal/multipart pair costs checked before GEOS
growth and near-budget admission fail before shape/overlay allocation
public output roundtrip retains planar flags
empty and lower-dimensional results remain real; Image.clip emits its exact Polygon/MultiPolygon-only error
Feature id conflicts/null geometry/unsupported receiver reject; copied left metadata cannot alias inputs
empty Feature-map callbacks validate names and required/unknown keyword structure without inventing rows

review.independent_read_only_contract_review: No remaining release-blocking contract/budget issue in frozen implementation

investigated_and_fixed: Aggregate pair/output admission originally followed input GEOS decode; moved complete admission before first handler GEOS/copy.
Initial output allowance refund lost actual mapping/materialization work; retain the charged conservative allowance.
Segment-only cross counts missed point interactions, internal noding and mixed outputs; include all primitive interactions and child bounds.
Raw ring equality could inspect mutable or cyclic coordinate leaves before validation; use conservative closure counts without equality.
Sidecar-only planar metadata was lost at public JSON; new output mappings expose false geodesic flags for official SDK roundtrip.
Feature overlay test expectations initially reused GEOS operations; replaced with literal rings and independent shoelace areas.
verification_failures_and_resolution: Initial combined target run:98passed1failed because the empty-output assertion lacked the new public geodesic=false flag. Corrected the exact expected metadata; complete frozen regression passes.

A trusted audit helper mistook the pre-existing point-constructor control for a Boolean predicate. Inspected its unchanged original wire, corrected the audit expectation to the actual Point and retained the failure log; no production change.
limits_and_unverified: Ordinary GEE Polygon/Rectangle defaults and omitted/null binary proj use spherical semantics and remain unsupported; explicit planar calls are a genuine partial subset.
Non-null ErrorMargin/maxError, other CRS/transform/reprojection, left-inside interiors, ambiguous edges and general Element/runtime Feature overloads remain open.
BBox dateline wrapping or coordinates beyond admitted WGS84 bounds can reject; no antimeridian, polar or Google boundary equivalence claim.
Valid geometry does not guarantee worst-case pair/output bounds fit current compiler limits. New native/Spark/HTTP/browser/deployment/Google/private-data acceptance not performed.
Existing default256square unmix and larger matrix/workflow resource limits remain unchanged.

default_spherical_next_step.status: Feasibility research only, no dependency or adapter installed
default_spherical_next_step.finding: Existing pinned stack has planar GEOS/JTS and projection tools, no spherical Boolean engine. Official S2 C++ Boolean API is a candidate, but GEE boundaries, loops, ErrorMargin, output rounding, planar-edge conversion and downstream raster consumers need independent implementation and verification. Do not substitute GEOS for default spherical calls.
